question:
A committee decides which predictions go into a time capsule, and three members always disagree. Play all three, then write the version they can agree on.

Steps:
1. Start recording. Pick one prediction from the list below.
2. Be the Optimist: say one real benefit.
3. Be the Skeptic: say one thing the evidence does not yet show. Then be the Fairness Officer: say one group who might be left out.
4. Say a one-sentence revised prediction with at least 2 limits, and tell us which voice changed it the most.

Prediction list:
- “By 2035, self-driving buses will run in every town.”
- “By 2035, an AI helper will assist doctors in every clinic.”
- “By 2035, every student will have an AI translator in class.”

rubric.description: Student does not play any voices on camera.
Student plays only one or two of the three voices.
Student plays all 3 voices (Optimist, Skeptic, and Fairness Officer) with one specific point each AND gives a one-sentence revised prediction.
Meets all of the above AND the revised prediction includes at least 2 limits (a condition, a time, or a group) AND says which voice changed it most and why.
